name: Member liability

subjectOf.text: If DAO members do not formalize a legal structure for their entity, courts are very likely to impose one on them, which is a serious risk of DAO membership.
subjectOf.abstract: However, a very serious risk is associated with DAO membership in the sense that if the DAO members do not formalize a structure for their human-created entity, courts are very likely to impose one for the members of the DAO.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3799320
scope_conditions: DAOs with no off-chain legal entity

subjectOf.text: Under the legal wrapper concept individual DAO members are not liable and the third party knows exactly with whom she is interacting and where liabilities arise.
subjectOf.abstract: Using the legal wrapper concept, the individual DAO members would not be liable and the third party knows exactly with whom she is interacting and where liabilities arise.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3799320
scope_conditions: DAO represented by a legal wrapper entity

subjectOf.text: A DAO operating without a legal wrapper risks being deemed a partnership by estoppel in legal disputes, exposing its members to liability, as scored for Hop DAO with a regulatory compliance score of 1.
subjectOf.abstract: Lacking a legal wrapper, it is at risk of being deemed a partnership by estoppel in legal disputes (R: 1).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Market Meta Analysis 2024 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5254152
scope_conditions: DAOs with no legal entity or legal wrapper
